query:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `terp_profile_plants` (
  `terp_profile_id` int NOT NULL,
  `plant_id` int NOT NULL,
  `notes` text,
  FOREIGN KEY (`terp_profile_id`) REFERENCES `terp_profiles`(`id`),
  FOREIGN KEY (`plant_id`) REFERENCES `plants`(`id`)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `terp_profile_molecules` (
  `terp_profile_id` int NOT NULL,
  `molecule_id` int NOT NULL,
  `percentage` decimal(5,2),
  `notes` text,
  FOREIGN KEY (`terp_profile_id`) REFERENCES `terp_profiles`(`id`),
  FOREIGN KEY (`molecule_id`) REFERENCES `molecules`(`id`)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `plant_molecules` (
  `plant_id` int NOT NULL,
  `molecule_id` int NOT NULL,
  `percentage` decimal(5,2),
  `is_signature` int DEFAULT 0,
  `notes` text,
  FOREIGN KEY (`plant_id`) REFERENCES `plants`(`id`),
  FOREIGN KEY (`molecule_id`) REFERENCES `molecules`(`id`)
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS `final_recipe_terp_profiles` (
  `final_recipe_id` int NOT NULL,
  `terp_profile_id` int NOT NULL,
  `percentage` decimal(5,2),
  `notes` text,
  FOREIGN KEY (`final_recipe_id`) REFERENCES `final_recipes`(`id`),
  FOREIGN KEY (`terp_profile_id`) REFERENCES `terp_profiles`(`id`)
);
